subject: Export home ranges as shape file

messages.author: f2e51a1a15eeaba8
messages.subject: Export home ranges as shape file
parts:
Hi Christen,

I have searched around in the internet and other sources and I am sure it is something very basic, but still I do not manage, probably because I am new to spacial analysis in R. I would simply like to export the home ranges (ellipses) as a shape file to be able to plot them in QGis. I have used the following script, it creates a shape file, but it is empty. This is the code I used.

dir<-"C:/Users/xxx/ShapesAKDE"
writeShapefile(akde.anakinsummer,
              dir, "anakinsummer",
               level.UD=0.95)

What do I wrong?
Thank you so much in advance for your answer,
cheers,
Elke

messages.author: 961f4ec0bd606336
messages.subject: Re: Export home ranges as shape file
parts:
Hi Elke,

Maybe you need to use alpha=0.95 instead of level.UD=0.95?
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/ctmm/versions/0.2.9/topics/ctmm%3A%3Aexport

Also, you could try this approach:

akde <- #your akde object

spdf <- SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(akde,level.UD=0.95,level=0.95)

From here, you could plot spdf to make sure it's not empty, etc. Then, write out the spdf to shapefile.

Ben

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Export home ranges as shape file
parts:
Hi Elke,

That looks like the correct usage of the function, as long as akde.anakinsummer is a UD object. One thing you can check is if SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD is working, like Ben suggested. If you are still having problems, then you can message/email a copy of data that can reproduce the error.

Best,
Chris
